storage_policy: Do not commit multi-gigabyte corpora to Git history. Keep immutable manifests, source revisions, checksums and curation reports in Git; keep bulk data in an explicitly configured object store or dataset host. GitHub Actions runners/artifacts are for bounded staging and audit, not permanent 500 GB storage.
